teacher_info.about_teacher:
I studied for 5 years at the University of the Witwatersrand where I received my Bachelors degree with Honours in Education. 

My specializations have geared me in the following ways: 
Foundation Phase Teaching - I am able to start teaching from the very basic levels of the English language to much more advanced levels.
Online Teaching and Learning - I know exactly how to structure my lessons within an online environment for optimal benefit to my students. 
Development of Online Materials - I can fully develop my own teaching and learning materials which I will use during my lessons.

I am very patient and understanding. We learn best from our mistakes, so don't be afraid to make them.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I will structure my lessons based on each of my students needs.

Whether my students want a structured lesson or a more informal conversational lesson, I can provide both, and anything in between.

I like to spend a few minutes at the beginning of each lesson to recap what was covered in the previous lesson. At the end of each lesson I can also issue additional homework for my students to complete in their own time to help reinforce what they are learning.

I encourage my students to ask as many questions as possible to ensure that they understand everything clearly before moving on. I believe that learning should be fun and I want all my students to feel comfortable and enjoy our lessons.

exp_info.description:
While studying for my Bachelors Degree in Education, I taught in various primary schools for a few months at a time to gain practical teaching experience.
I taught for a combined total of 12 months spread across the duration of 5 years, and at a total of 8 different schools.

I tutor students in my neighborhood. I help them with English as well as other subjects. This has taught me how to engage with students of different ages and backgrounds, and how to structure my lessons accordingly. It has also helped me develop better one-on-one teaching methods and ways of interacting with a single student as opposed to an entire class.

course_info.trial_description:
In this trail lesson, we'll firstly break the ice by getting to know each other. 
Then we'll discuss your goals and decide on a plan of action together, I think it's important that you are a part of the process so that you can start to get excited about growing, learning and most importantly reaching your goals.

So book a trail with me and let's thrive together!

pro_course_detail.title: Business English with Anara
pro_course_detail.description:
1) Open class with light conversation, I will ask about their day, week or weekend
2) As discussed in trail, we'll revisit their goals and set our objectives for the day 
vocabulary & key phrases 
3) Introduce key terms (5-6 word or phrases that are relevant) with definitions and context
4) Have student make sentences with Key terms or read short sentences (use words)
5) Answer/ask questions about key terms to check understanding & have student pick two terms to talk about briefly.
role-play activity
6) Explain a scenario and set objectives 
7) Practice round 1
8) Swop roles and practice round 2
9) Feedback and correction (make sure new key word were used correctly) 
10) Challenge student by going "off script" to see how they respond 
 Reading or Listening Exercise  
11) Read/listen to relevant content 
12) Comprehension and discussion 
Feedback & wrap up 
13) Recap: what we did, areas to improve, ask student where they think they need more focus
Homework & next steps
14) Use the new key words in an assignment ( create scenario, write a paragraph, etc..) or assign a reading exercise.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS prep with Anara
pro_course_detail.description:
Warm up - Light conversation & address concerns
Goals recap - Revisit goals discussed in trial, discuss their pain points and concerns
IELTS format - review structure & identify priority areas 
Speaking part 1 questions - feedback 
Speaking part 2 questions - feedback 
Reading/ Listening 
Read short paragraph - answers questions -review
Listen to a video clip - answer questions - review 
Writing tips & quick practice - with topic - brainstorm how they would respond 
Do they writing exercise - review - feedback 
Next steps - action plan 
Homework - based on their performance in class

task based or conversational based exercise

Short listening segment - discussion 
Short reading segment - comprehension 
Follow up questions/discussion 
Speaking challenge 
Recap key points - feedback
Homework - discuss in next class
Set the focus for next class

pro_course_detail.title: Beginner English - Alphabets and Phonics
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson introduces the English alphabet and basic phonics to help with letter recognition and pronunciation. Students will learn letter sounds, simple word formation, and practice through fun activities to build confidence in reading and speaking.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversational
pro_course_detail.description: I offer engaging conversational classes designed to help students build confidence in speaking and listening. Through interactive activities like role-plays, discussions, and debates, I focus on real-life scenarios to help students improve their fluency, pronunciation, and everyday communication skills. My goal is to create a supportive learning environment where students can practice speaking naturally, expand their vocabulary, and engage confidently in English conversations.

pro_course_detail.title: English Grammar and Sentence Structure
pro_course_detail.description: These classes will focus on improving your understanding of English grammar and sentence structure. We’ll focus on key elements like subjects, verbs, and objects, and how they form different types of sentences—statements, questions, and commands. You'll learn how to use parts of speech (nouns, verbs, adjectives, etc.) correctly and build sentences that are clear and accurate. Through interactive activities, we’ll practice sentence construction, error correction, and punctuation to help you speak and write with confidence and clarity !

pro_course_detail.title: English Reading and Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
In our reading lessons, we will focus on building reading fluency and improving your pronunciation through practice with various texts. We will also work on interpreting articles and understanding the main ideas, key details, and the overall message. You will practice reading out loud to improve accuracy, speed, and expression.

In our writing lessons, we will focus on writing coherent passages, ensuring your ideas are well-organized and clearly expressed. We will also spend time correcting and editing your work, helping you refine your sentence structure, punctuation, and vocabulary. Through this process, you will gain confidence in both writing and revising your own work to make it more polished and effective.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English, If you can dream it, you can do it. – Walt Disney
pro_course_detail.description: These fun, interactive lessons are a welcome break from the pages and pages of grammar found in  workbooks. Students will feel confident that they can use their newly mastered English language with people in the real world in every day scenarios, making the value of their English knowledge and grasp of the language more apparent.

pro_course_detail.title: Structured Learning Focused On Reading Writing Speaking
pro_course_detail.description: These interesting and enjoyable lessons allow you to focus on all key points of the English language, Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking. Each lesson is structured around a reading piece based on a current event or news. We then expand on that and work on pronunciation  corrections and vocabulary expansion. We also work on various exercises to help us remember and apply what we have just learnt using our writing and memory skills. Lastly we discuss what we have read and work on our communications skills .

pro_course_detail.title: Structured Lessons - Grammar Exercises
pro_course_detail.description:
In these fun lessons we will work on Grammar using worksheets and exercises to gain a good grasp of how each grammar rule works. It is  very important to take things slowly and focus on one grammar rule at a time, read up about each rule, practise it and then practise some more. 
This is the best way to be able to memorise and understand all the grammar rules that you will need to become a fluent English speaker. 
We will work on the aspects of grammar which you would like to focus on such as prepositions, tenses and many more exciting grammar points.
This class is for students with an pre intermediate or higher level of English , I really enjoy these lesson and find them exciting and fun.
